verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an agent creating or composing a dashboard of chosen metrics through the API or MCP server. The official MCP server is described as bringing behavioral context into AI tools "to get answers." The Dashboard REST API only reads data already displayed on dashboard graphs. The Wizard CLI's "first dashboard" is an instrumentation bootstrap, not API or MCP dashboard authoring. These are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server
